verdict.rationale: Dialpad is a business calling and messaging platform, so toll-free verification for texting is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers a guided toll-free verification submission, a visible verification status, or texting being blocked until approval. The only messaging-related item is company-wide number blocking, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, toll-free verification is a guided submission with visible status, and the product says texting stays blocked until approval
